metadata.source_priority: Official GPP parking definitions; geometry derived from supplied OpenStreetMap export.
metadata.production_rule: Render MAPPED features normally. REVIEW_REQUIRED features must not be presented as exact parking boundaries until field/manual verification.
changes_from_candidate: OS-Z1-005 Školska ulica: removed MultiLineString part located in Višnjevac; remaining coordinates unchanged.
OS-Z0-006 Šepera 8E–8F: whole promenade footway replaced by OSM parking way 38066699 (tagged parking:zone=0, operator GPP Osijek).
OS-Z0-011 Trg Ljudevita Gaja – sjever: road fallback replaced by OSM parking way 1357072196 (Radićeva–Neumanova).
OS-Z0-012 Trg Ljudevita Gaja – istok i Sudski prolaz: road fallback replaced by east-side market car parks and the court passage car park.
OS-Z0-012 and OS-Z1-002 (Zeko): positions confirmed by the author 2026-09-27; status set to MAPPED, coordinates unchanged.
OS-Z0-006, OS-Z0-011, OS-Z0-012: special_rule and notes translated to Croatian (same meaning).
OS-Z0-007 Strossmayerova: restored from official dataset; geometry = OSM parking way 679845295 (tagged parking:zone=0, operator GPP Osijek).
Added every street and car park coloured on GPP's official map "Sve zone parkiranja" (Zone 0, I and II), geometry from OpenStreetMap, active_from 2026-10-01 as requested by the author.
Zone 0/I map additions active_from 2026-09-30; Zone II active_from 2026-11-09 (City of Osijek: "oko 9. studenoga").
